 By Chicago Tribune PUBLISHED: November 3, 2026 at 2:45 AM CST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... In a historic first for Chicago, all 21 school board seats will be on the November ballot. The board was previously composed of seven mayoral appointees, but is currently in a two-year transition period, split between 10 elected and 11 appointed members.
 What to know before you vote in Chicago’s elected school board races 
 Voting in Chicago’s school board elections? Find your district with our lookup tool. 
 Polls will be open in Illinois from 6 a.m. to 7 p.m. Anyone in line by 7 p.m. will be allowed to vote.
 Votes will be counted in contested races after polls close in Illinois. See statewide election results here . Any last-minute questions about voting? View our voter guide.
